item.title: The lr:hq minimap2 profile speeds up Emu by an order of magnitude for 16S data
item.description: Emu is a popular read classifier and abundance estimator for 16S sequencing (sequencing of the 16S ribosomal RNA subunit, which is a common method for determining the abundance of bacteria in a sample, typically at the granularity of genus and/or species). We use it as part of the Trana pipeline for a selection of 16S sequencing samples at the Karolinska Hospital. Emu was specifically created to account for the generally lower accuracy of Oxford Nanopore (ONT) reads.
